strategy.thesis: National umbrella body operating the Angel Investment Support Center (엔젤투자지원센터): cultivates accredited angel investors, registers and manages angel clubs (엔젤클럽) and individual investment partnerships (개인투자조합), and runs the Angel Investment Matching Fund that co-invests alongside angels in early-stage startups.

application.how_to_apply: Angel investors and angel clubs register via the Angel Investment Support Center (엔젤투자지원센터) at kban.or.kr; clubs need a chair, secretary and 5+ members (or members with qualifying investment records / completed angel education) to register.

summary.en: KBAN (Korea Business Angels Association) is South Korea's national angel-investment umbrella, established in 2012 and commissioned by the SME authority to run the Angel Investment Support Center. It registers and supports accredited angels, angel clubs and individual investment partnerships, and administers the Angel Investment Matching Fund that co-invests with angels in early-stage startups. As of December 2023, 31,478 angel investors and 261 angel clubs were registered nationwide.
summary.local: (사)한국엔젤투자협회(KBAN)는 2012년 9월 설립된 엔젤투자 분야 대표 협회로, 엔젤투자지원센터를 운영하며 엔젤투자자·엔젤클럽·개인투자조합 등록 및 엔젤투자매칭펀드를 관리한다. 2023년 12월 기준 누적 등록 엔젤투자자는 31,478명, 엔젤클럽은 261개다.

summary.en: NextDream Angel Club is a Seoul angel club registered with KBAN in September 2018. Founded with 6 members, it grew to 149 members by 2024 (roughly 24x), drawing on finance-sector professionals and specialists (doctors, lawyers, patent attorneys, CEOs) who invest in seed to pre-Series A startups and form individual investment partnerships per deal. It won a Minister of SMEs and Startups commendation for angel-investment activation in 2022.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the club website or partner platform (Seoul Exchange angel club); accredited/specialist members preferred.

summary.en: A.I. (Accredited Investors) Angel Club, founded around 2015 by dentist Choi Sung-ho, is a Seoul angel club specializing in biotech/medical/healthcare seed investing. As of 2018 it had 29 members (including 9 doctors plus executives, VCs, patent attorneys and accountants) and had invested ~4.2 billion won across 23 companies, with members providing domain-specific consulting. It markets itself as Korea's largest certified bio/healthcare angel club.

strategy.thesis: Syndicate / club-deal platform for unlisted startup stock: a lead angel (리드엔젤, 업무집행조합원) secures shares in a promising startup and forms an individual investment partnership (개인투자조합) so retail investors can co-invest in small amounts (club deal). Covers the full cycle from lead-angel selection to partnership formation, member recruitment, contracting, and secondary trading/exit.

track_record.portfolio_count: 20+ club deals (~1.5bn won) by May 2020; cumulative transaction volume over 20 billion won by Sept 2021

application.how_to_apply: Sign up on the AngelLeague app/website to join a club deal led by a lead angel; lead angels apply to form syndicates.

summary.en: Angel League (operated by CapBox, renamed to Angel League in 2021) is a Korean syndicate / club-deal platform founded in October 2019 by Oh Hyun-seok. A lead angel (리드엔젤) secures shares in a promising pre-IPO startup and forms an individual investment partnership so retail investors can co-invest in small amounts and become shareholders; the platform handles the full lifecycle including secondary trading and exit. It launched its app in February 2021, crossed 10 billion won cumulative volume in March/April 2021 and over 20 billion won by September 2021, and was selected for TIPS in 2021.
summary.local: 엔젤리그(운영사 캡박스, 2021년 엔젤리그로 사명 변경)는 2019년 10월 오현석 대표가 설립한 비상장 주식 신디케이트·클럽딜 플랫폼이다. 리드엔젤(업무집행조합원)이 유망 스타트업 주식을 확보해 개인투자조합을 결성하고, 일반 투자자가 소액으로 공동투자(클럽딜)해 주주가 될 수 있게 한다. 2021년 2월 앱 출시 후 같은 해 9월 누적 거래액 200억원을 돌파했고 2021년 TIPS에 선정됐다.

strategy.thesis: Platform that lets anyone become an angel investor by joining an angel club and forming an individual investment partnership (개인투자조합) per deal to invest in early-stage startups; partners with established angel clubs (NextDream, AI Angel Club, Hexagon) for deal flow. Designated as a Financial Services Commission Innovative Financial Service company.

application.how_to_apply: Join an angel club through the Seoul Exchange platform and participate in per-deal individual investment partnerships.

summary.en: Seoul Exchange Angel Investment is a Korean platform (designated a Financial Services Commission Innovative Financial Service company) that lets individuals become angel investors by joining angel clubs and forming a per-deal individual investment partnership to invest in seed-stage startups and become shareholders. It surfaces deals through partner angel clubs including NextDream Angel Club, AI Angel Club and Hexagon Investment Consulting, and highlights the 100% income tax deduction available on angel investments up to 30 million won.

strategy.thesis: Open monthly network/forum for Korean startup stakeholders connecting founders with angel investors; hosts startup IR pitches, trend talks and panels on angel-investment activation, and runs joint forums with Angel Leaders Forum and TIPS in cooperation with the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and KBAN.

application.how_to_apply: Attend monthly forum events (last Tuesday of each month); founders apply to pitch via the forum website.

summary.en: GoVenture Forum is an open Korean startup network founded in 2007 by chairman Ko Young-ha, holding monthly events (last Tuesday of each month) that connect founders with angel investors through startup IR pitches, trend briefings and panels on activating angel investment. It runs joint forums with the Angel Leaders Forum and TIPS in cooperation with the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and the Korea Business Angels Association, and broadcasts events on its YouTube channel.
